summary: Floyd County tower on privately owned land: an 80-foot Aermotor built in the 1940s with its watchman's cabin still standing; standing and on the Register since 2017.

access.note: Register lists a private owner and withholds coordinates at the owner's request; no visitor information given

events.note: Register gives only 'the 1940s'; 1940 stands in for that decade, not a confirmed year

evidence.supports: 80-foot Aermotor tower; watchman's cabin fully standing
evidence.quote: This 80' Aermotor is one of the only Virginia towers where the watchman's cabin remains fully standing.
Coordinates are unlisted at owner's request

evidence.supports: also listed as Haycock Knob (Pocket Ridge)
listed under the name Haycock Knob
Forest Lookouts Virginia index lists Haycock Mountain in Floyd County
county on the index entry for Haycock Mountain

corrections.why: The Register lists a private owner, so public access is not expected
'Private owner' describes ownership, not an agency

corrections.current: brief coordinates, which the FFLA list publishes
corrections.proposed: withhold or mask on public pages
corrections.why: The Register says coordinates are unlisted at the owner's request, yet the FFLA list still publishes them

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the Register gives build decade, owner and cabin detail; the Association supplies standing status and the alternate name. The Forest Lookouts page for this tower was not in the cache; only its Virginia index listing was used. No staffing or fire history in any source. Coordinates: the brief's lat/lon come from the FFLA list, which conflicts with the Register's request that they be unlisted. Recommend the editor decide whether to mask them; the story does not give them.
